scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -k -n server,client -c teal,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: node init && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
